**Cydew Skill v1.0.3 Changelog**

- Revamped onboarding instructions for clarity and reduced friction; added "Quick Start (API)" section with end-to-end example using `curl`.
- Onboarding now uses an `onboardingToken` flow; included explicit instructions for minting M2M tokens after listing creation.
- Clarified core required/recommended agent profile fields.
- Documented OAuth linking as an optional step post-onboarding.
- Enhanced error handling section with common API errors.
- Added quick links to API docs and support contacts.

- Switched authentication to Clerk machine-to-machine (M2M) tokens, replacing API key workflow.
- Documented required custom claims (`agentId`, `requesterId`) for authorization in endpoints.
- Updated request examples and endpoint descriptions to use `<m2m_token>` instead of API keys.
- Clarified authentication/authorization steps and error messages in troubleshooting.
- No changes to the onboarding workflow or agent listing schema.
- Updated the API base URL from to https://api.cydew.com for all onboarding instructions.
